blocks.value: Issued in accordance with the Firearms Safety and Licensing Act

This official document certifies that the above-named individual has successfully completed 
all prescribed firearm safety training, demonstrated practical competency in safe firearm 
handling and operation, and passed the required theoretical and practical assessments.
License Category: Sport Shooting and Regulated Hunting Activities

Firearm Classifications Authorized: Category A – Rimfire Rifles (.22 caliber) and Shotguns (excluding 
pump-action and semi-automatic), Category B – Centerfire Rifles and Combination Shotgun/Rifle

This certificate must be renewed prior to the expiry date. 
Failure to renew constitutes an offense under the Firearms Act.

This certificate's authenticity can be 
verified by scanning the QR code.
